objective: Close S1 evidence gaps and independently verify E2E execution without forensic promotion.

BOT2_QUANT.action: Independently audit S1 raw capture coverage, date completeness, quantitative consistency, raw-byte versus semantic hash semantics, and unresolved conflict evidence. Identify the smallest admissible evidence needed to close each quantitative predicate.
BOT2_QUANT.deliverable: persistent worker result with evidence_refs, predicate-by-predicate status, minority/challenge notes, and recommended next execution step

BOT3_REALITY.action: Independently verify source provenance and acquisition-channel evidence for S1. Search persistent repo evidence for lawful acquisition reference, authorized/manual capture, durable archive/export, timestamps, provenance and reproducibility. If absent, return explicit evidence-gap/HOLD rather than inference.
BOT3_REALITY.deliverable: persistent worker result with source/provenance evidence_refs, predicate-by-predicate status, conflicts/minority notes, and safe next action

BOT4_EXECUTION.action: Independently verify current worker/deployment/runtime execution path, receipt freshness, allocation/lease identity, deployment binding and replay/stale protection. Attempt runtime evidence where authorized; if infrastructure context is unavailable, record the exact blocker and evidence gap.
BOT4_EXECUTION.deliverable: persistent worker result with runtime/deployment evidence_refs, execution status, receipt lineage and safe next action

completion_rule: All three workers must return persistent results bound to this allocation_id/cycle_id before reconciliation. Missing, stale or conflicting results cause HOLD/ESCALATE. Worker PASS is local only and cannot promote S1.
next_reconciliation: BOT1_LEAD reconciles freshness, identity, evidence completeness, conflicts and authority boundaries, then reads canonical next_action.json before continuation.
